en.headline: Hong Kong men’s foil team reach Asian Games semi-finals
en.dek: Ryan Choi, Cheung Ka-long, Harris Ho and Leung Chin-yu beat Uzbekistan 45-33 in the quarter-finals in Nagoya, guaranteeing at least a bronze medal.
body: Hong Kong’s men’s foil team advanced to the semi-finals of the Asian Games on Friday after a 45-33 victory over Uzbekistan at the Aichi Sky Expo Hall in Nagoya.

The squad of Ryan Choi Chun-yin, Cheung Ka-long, Harris Ho Shing-him and Leung Chin-yu had earlier eliminated India in the last 16. Reaching the last four automatically secures a medal, as the competition has no bronze-medal match.
They will face defending champions South Korea in the semi-finals later on Friday. Japan and China contest the other semi-final. Choi won individual silver earlier in the week.

zh.headline: 港隊男花團體淘汰烏茲別克 亞運闖四強穩奪牌
zh.dek: 蔡俊彥、張家朗、何承謙及梁千雨周五在名古屋以45：33擊敗烏茲別克，四強對南韓，至少穩奪銅牌。
body: 香港男子花劍團體周五在名古屋亞運以45：33擊敗烏茲別克，成功晉級四強。
由蔡俊彥、張家朗、何承謙及梁千雨組成的港隊，早前已淘汰印度晉級八強。由於賽事不設銅牌戰，晉身四強已至少穩奪一面獎牌。
港隊稍後將對衛冕的南韓。另一邊半決賽由日本對中國。蔡俊彥本周稍早已取得個人銀牌。
